$comment: BC AI Compass — verified organization records. Tier A only: every record's evidenceQuote was copied from a page actually fetched at evidenceUrl on evidenceDate. Spot-check by opening evidenceUrl and searching the page for evidenceQuote. A quote not on the page is a fabrication and invalidates the record.
verifier: claude.ai session, reviewed by Martin Montero

records.name: DIGITAL
records.blurb: One of Canada's Global Innovation Clusters, co-investing federal and industry money in applied technology projects. Runs a dedicated artificial intelligence program stream alongside health, mining and energy, workforce and dual-use technology streams.
records.evidenceQuote: 2127 – 1055 W. Georgia Street Vancouver, BC, V6E 3P3
records.notes: Naming is genuinely mixed on the organization's own site: footer and copyright read DIGITAL, navigation and page titles still read Digital Technology Supercluster, LinkedIn is registered as digital-global-innovation-cluster. Active as of August 2026 (site carries news dated 2026-08-06). The existing dataset holds two rows, both under the retired name, categorised inconsistently.

records.name: CAIDA — Centre for AI Decision-making and Action
records.location: ICICS Building, 2366 Main Mall, UBC Vancouver campus
records.blurb: UBC's interdisciplinary artificial intelligence research centre, sitting within the Institute for Computing, Information and Cognitive Systems. Its focus is AI systems for decision-making and action, and it runs seminar series, industry outreach and the AIM-SI faculty cluster.
records.keyPeople: Kevin Leyton-Brown (Director); Leonid Sigal and Michiel van de Panne (Deputy Directors); Alan Mackworth (Past Director)
records.notes: COLLISION HAZARD: caida.org is the Center for Applied Internet Data Analysis in San Diego, unrelated, and is the first result a naive search returns. The existing dataset's caida.ca is wrong. Membership figures differ across CAIDA's own pages (83 professors / 24 units; 100+ / 27; 100+ / 30) — use 100+ across 30 from the AIM-SI page, which references 2026 hires, or leave null.

records.name: Quantum Algorithms Institute
records.blurb: A non-profit working to grow British Columbia's applied quantum sector by building quantum literacy in business, running training and professional development, and supporting pilot projects that apply quantum methods to real problems.
records.evidenceQuote: advancing the growth, adoption, and strategic development of quantum technologies in British Columbia
records.notes: REGION AND LOCATION DELIBERATELY NULL. The current site publishes no physical address on any page and has no contact page in its navigation. The Surrey address 295-13450 102 Avenue V3T 5X3 appears only on the legacy quantumalgorithms.ca footer and on Facebook, neither of which meets the evidence standard. DOMAIN CORRECTION: the existing dataset holds three rows split across quantumalgorithms.ca and quantumalgorithms.org; the live domain is qai.ca. A fourth variant, quantumalgorithmsinstitute.ca, appears on the organization's own Facebook page.

records.name: First Nations Technology Council
records.blurb: An Indigenous-led non-profit mandated by the First Nations Leadership Council to advance digital literacy, connectivity and technology strategy for all 204 First Nations in British Columbia. Its AI work includes an introductory AI course written for Indigenous people and organizations, and published research on First Nations perspectives on artificial intelligence.
records.evidenceQuote: Suite 1707, 1370 Senakw Lane Vancouver BC, V6J 0J5
records.notes: DOMAIN CORRECTION: technologycouncil.ca still resolves but serves the new site, whose every page declares canonical firstnationstech.ca. ADDRESS CORRECTION: the 70 Orwell Street, North Vancouver address persists on the organization's Facebook page and on third-party directories and is stale. Founded 2002. Its mandate is province-wide rather than tied to one region — the region model needs to handle province-wide organizations.

records.name: DigiBC
nameVariants: Creative Technology Industry Association of British Columbia
records.blurb: The industry association for British Columbia's creative technology sector, representing member companies across video games, animation, visual effects, XR and virtual production, along with post-secondary and service organizations. Works on advocacy, talent pipeline, equity and community programming.
records.evidenceQuote: #160-577 Great Northern Way Vancouver, BC, V5T 1E1
records.notes: MERGE REQUIRED: the existing dataset carries New Media BC as a separate live organization at newmediabc.com with a named Executive Director who is not DigiBC's. DigiBC's own history states it was founded in 1997 under the name New Media BC, with a merger and renaming in January 2009. New Media BC is a defunct predecessor and must be merged in as a name variant, not listed. ADDRESS CONFLICT: BC Tech Association's member directory lists DigiBC at 14 East 6th Avenue; DigiBC's own site wins.

records.name: BC Tech Association
records.location: 210-1401 West 8th Avenue, Vancouver (mailing address; the team is fully virtual)
records.blurb: British Columbia's cross-sector technology industry association, running member programs, accelerators, talent and immigration initiatives and advocacy. Its AI-specific programming includes a vertical accelerator aimed at AI companies.
records.notes: The organization states it operates as a fully virtual team, so this is a mailing address rather than a place people go. The map needs a rule for virtual-first organizations; they will not be rare. The existing dataset's separate 'BC Tech AI C-Council' row is likely the same programme under an older name and must be checked before shipping as a distinct organization. Evidence page is a member-directory page on their own domain carrying their footer; a dedicated about-page fetch would be a stronger source.

records.name: Innovate BC
records.blurb: A Crown agency of the British Columbia government that supports technology and innovation through hiring grants, mentorship, research grants, pilot funding and innovation challenges, and advises government on technology policy.
records.evidenceQuote: Innovate BC is a Crown agency of the B.C. government
records.notes: REPORTING MINISTRY UNRESOLVED — DO NOT PUBLISH. The page fetched here, last updated 2026-03-09, states it reports to the Ministry of Jobs and Economic Growth. A separate gov.bc.ca crown-corporation page updated 2026-06-22 states Ministry of Finance. Both are government sources. The later date favours Finance, and the 2026-08-14 cabinet shuffle complicates it further. Leave the field null until settled from a single dated page. Region null: the fetched page carries no head-office address.

records.name: BC + AI Ecosystem Association
records.blurb: A member-funded non-profit building British Columbia's public-interest AI community, grown out of a monthly Vancouver meetup into regional chapters, special-interest groups, certification programmes and an annual festival.
records.evidenceQuote: 300+ paying members of the nonprofit building British Columbia's AI industry
records.notes: URL CORRECTION: the existing dataset records this organization at vancouver.bc-ai.net. Incorporated August 2025. CHAPTERS: the About page names Surrey, Squamish and Comox Valley as launched chapters; the press kit names Vancouver, Surrey and Comox Valley and omits Squamish, which may be dormant. Fraser Valley (FV+AI) launches 2026-09-09 in Langley and is not yet in the press kit. FOUNDING DATE CONFLICT on their own pages: About says the meetup started 2023, press kit says 2024. Do not publish a founding year until settled. This is the organization the Compass is built for; its own record should be reviewed by Kris before publication.
